title: Hai Nabi se mohabbat ka dawa jise
body:
HAI NABI SE MOHABBAT KA DAWA JISE
UNKI AWLAD SE DUSHMANI CHHODH DE
<<DIVIDER>>
GAR SHAFA’AT PAIYAMBAR SE DARKAR HAI
UNKE AGYAAR KI DOSTI CHHODH DE
<<DIVIDER>>
ZILLATO MA’ZERAT MASIYAT KE SEWA
DAMAN-E-GHAIR MEIN AUR KUCH BHI NAHI
<<DIVIDER>>
UNKE SAAYE SE DARR UNSE BACH KAR NIKAL
NOOR-E-IMAAN MEIN AA GUMRAHI CHHODH DE
<<DIVIDER>>
APNE RAB SE BAZAAHIR TO DARTA HAI TU
LAMBI LAMBI NAMAZEIN BHI PADHTA HAI TU
<<DIVIDER>>
AUR KHAAMI NAHI KOI TUJH MEIN BADI
KHAHISHE NAFS KI PAIRWI CHHODH DE
<<DIVIDER>>
DEEN-E-HAQ KO ZARURAT JO SACHCHON KI THI
SAR PE BAANDHE KAFAN AA GAYE PANJATAN
<<DIVIDER>>
AISE SACHCHON KI TAKZEEB KARTA HO JO
CHAHIYE USKO DEENE NABI CHHODH DE
<<DIVIDER>>
TUNE BAKKHIN KAHA MARHABA MARHABA
KEH DIYA THA TO PHIR USSE PHIR KYON GAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
JO KAHA KAR USE PHIR NIBHAYA BHI KAR
GAR MUNAFIQ NAHI DO RUKHI CHHODH DE
<<DIVIDER>>
NAJDIYAT KHARJIYAT KI AWLAAD HAI
NAFRATO ASBIYAT INTESHAARO NIFAAQ
<<DIVIDER>>
AMN QAYEM ZAMAANE MEIN HO JAAYEGA
AALE ATHAAR SE DUSHMANI CHHOD DE
<<DIVIDER>>
HAI JO TUJH PAR GIRAAN NAAM-E-MUSHKIL KUSHA
TU JO MUNKIR HADEES-E-KISA KA HUWA
<<DIVIDER>>
YUN TO DEEN-E-MOHAMMAD SE BAAHAR HAI TU
KAM SE KAM NISBAT-E-JAFARI CHHODH DE
<<DIVIDER>>
KHARJI NAASBI MARHABI ANTARI
MUTTAHID HO KE AAYE MUQAABIL TERE
<<DIVIDER>>
BADH KE MISLE KHUMAINI UNHE ROK DE
WARNA PHIR NARA-E-HAIDERI CHHOD DE
<<DIVIDER>>
JO DOSTDARE NABIYO ALI HAIN WAHI
APNE KIRDAR SE BHI JO SAABIT KARE
<<DIVIDER>>
KYON WO KEHTA HAI JO KHUD BI KARTA NAHI
LEADARI CHHOD YA REHZANI CHHOD DE
<<DIVIDER>>
CHUGHLIYAAN GHEEBATEIN BUGZO KEENA HASAD
TOHMATO ITTEHAAMO NIFAAQO RIYA
<<DIVIDER>>
JO BURI AADATEIN HAIN SABHI CHHOD DE
CHHOD DE CHHOD DE AUR ABHI CHHOD DE
<<DIVIDER>>
TERE NAZDEEK KIRDAR KUCH BHI NAHI
TU FAQAT MARDE GUFTAAR HAI WAYEZA
<<DIVIDER>>
KHUD AMAL KARKE AURON KO TALQEEN KAR
WARZA LAFFAZI-O-ZAKIRI CHHOD DE
<<DIVIDER>>
HUM TO NAAT-O-SANA MARSIYE KE SIWA
SHAAYERI KUCH NAHI JEE KA JANJAAL HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
HAI YE TERE LIYE BHI MAZARRAT RASAAN
AB MERI MAAN LE SHAAYERI CHHOD DE
<<DIVIDER>>
AAP APNE GAREBAAN BHI JHAANK LE
APNI ISLAAH KAR SAB SUDHAR JAAYENGE
<<DIVIDER>>
SIRF BATEIN NA KAR, SIBTE JAFAR NA BAN
BAD ZABAANI SE BACH BADZANI CHHOD DE
author: Sibte Jaffer Shaheed
